description: Encode UTF-8 text to Base64 / Base64URL / Base32 / Hex (keyless, offline). Set `variant` (default base64).

text.description: Text to encode. (`data` and `input` are accepted as aliases; one of the three is required, enforced by the tool as user_error.)

variant.description: Encoding: base64 (default), base64url, base32, or hex.

name: base64_base64_encode
title: Base64 Base64 Encode
